verdict.rationale: Kit documents per-broadcast stats limited to recipients, opens, clicks, unsubscribes and per-link clicks, plus account-level growth stats for a time period. Nothing in the evidence ties signups or revenue to a specific email, sequence or automation, so the story's core of going beyond opens and clicks is unevidenced. Selling digital products and importing purchase data exist, but no evidence links those sales back to individual emails or flows.
